triage_rationale: COMPLEX task requiring multi-domain changes across 21+ files. Four new feature domains: (1) Expanded signal adjustments — currently only contrast/brightness/gamma/dither exist in AsciiRenderOptions; needs saturation, hue, sharpness, denoise, and chroma subsampling controls across types.ts, contracts.ts, canvas-renderer.ts, ControlPanel.tsx; (2) Background removal / smart detector — entirely new feature requiring body-segmentation ML model integration or luminance-threshold approach with a configurable slider, affecting MediaPicker, ControlPanel, canvas-renderer, and contracts; (3) Audio passthrough for video ASCII — VideoStreamingEngine currently has video.muted=true and no audio path; needs WebAudio API integration to extract and route video audio to system output simultaneously with ASCII rendering, plus optional voice/speech-to-text overlay; (4) Widget-like fastfetch aesthetic — new UI mode requiring fastfetch-style terminal dashboard with real-time stats, GPU info, system monitor integration. Changes span React components, engine files, contracts/types, Tauri bridge, Python backend, and CSS.
framework: Tauri v2 + React 19 + Vite 6 + TypeScript 5.8 + Tailwind CSS 3.4 + Python 3.10 (ascii_art/) + Rust/Tauri sidecar

architectural_patterns.state_management: React built-in useState/useCallback/useRef in App.tsx (1222 lines) with StreamPipeline, VideoStreamingEngine, and MediaEngineService classes; no global state library; all shared refs live in App.tsx and shared across ALL modes causing workspace conflicts
architectural_patterns.data_fetching: No server actions or React Query; all rendering client-side via WebGPU/WebGL/Canvas2D tiers + Rust sidecar IPC via Tauri; video pipeline uses VideoStreamingEngine with onFrame callback; Python backend uses ffmpeg for video decode and ffplay for audio
architectural_patterns.routing: No router — tab-based navigation via URLSearchParams (?mode=procedural_3d|image|video|camera_stream|settings|media_picker) in App.tsx
architectural_patterns.styling_engine: Tailwind CSS 3.4.17 + CSS custom properties in src/index.css; pure monochrome B/W (#000000/#FFFFFF/#121212/#FAFAFA/#0a0a0c/#141416); DARK_MINIMALIST_TOKENS in contracts.ts
architectural_patterns.rendering_pipeline: Triple-path: (A) Procedural 3D via StreamPipeline + renderProcedural3D with zbuffer; (B) Image/Video via paintAsciiToCanvas() which ALWAYS uses canvas.getContext('2d').fillText regardless of tier — WebGPU/WebGL renderers in src/lib/renderers/ exist but are NEVER wired into App.tsx; (C) Rust sidecar via Tauri IPC for heavy batch image conversion; src/lib/renderers/webgpu.ts and webgl.ts have actual shader implementations but dead code
architectural_patterns.video_pipeline: VideoStreamingEngine class with loadSource/play/pause/stop/seek methods; onFrame callback calls paintAsciiToCanvas(canvasRef.current, ...); video.muted=true for browser autoplay compliance; NO audio output path exists; separate Python audio via ffplay in ascii_art/media/video.py but not integrated with Tauri frontend
architectural_patterns.audio_pipeline: None integrated in frontend. Python backend has _start_audio() using ffplay subprocess for terminal video playback. Frontend has no WebAudio API usage. MediaEngineService.startCamera has audio: config.audio ?? false but audio track is captured, never played
architectural_patterns.animation: CSS keyframes only (mediaStateReveal 180ms). BootLoadingScreen has 1.2s orchestrated reveal. Exactly 1 motion moment currently. No Framer Motion
architectural_patterns.design_tokens: DARK_MINIMALIST_TOKENS in contracts.ts already has pure monochrome palette; CSS variables in index.css already match; no redesign needed for this mission
architectural_patterns.signal_adjustments_current: AsciiRenderOptions has: contrast (-100..100), brightness (-100..100), gamma (0.1..3.0), dither (none/floyd_steinberg/ordered_bayer/atkinson). Applied in canvas-renderer.ts via factor=(259*(c+255))/(255*(259-c)) formula for contrast, brightnessOffset addition, invGamma pow() for gamma. No saturation, hue, sharpness, denoise, or chroma controls
architectural_patterns.background_removal_current: None. No body-segmentation, luminance-threshold, or chroma-key logic exists. Images rendered as-is from pixels to ASCII
architectural_patterns.audio_current: VideoStreamingEngine sets video.muted=true to comply with browser autoplay policy. No audio passthrough, no WebAudio API usage, no voice/speech detection

Browser autoplay policy requires video.muted=true for automated playback. Audio passthrough must use WebAudio API with MediaElementSourceNode from the muted video element, routing audio to destination. This is technically feasible but adds complexity.

canvas-renderer.ts does pixel-by-pixel sampling with nested loops (ty*tx*sy*sx). Adding saturation, hue, sharpness, denoise, and background removal to this pipeline could significantly degrade performance for 240-col grids. May need Web Worker offloading or WebGPU compute shader.

ControlPanel.tsx is already 797 lines. Adding 5+ new slider sections for signal adjustments, background removal, and audio controls will push toward 1000+ lines. Should extract sections into sub-components.

Tauri CSP in tauri.conf.json restricts connect-src to 'self' and ipc:. Any external ML model loading for background removal (e.g., from CDN) would violate CSP. Must use either bundled WASM model or Tauri-sidecar ML inference.

App.tsx is 1222 lines with deeply nested callback logic, shared refs across all render modes. Adding new state domains (audio, bg removal, widget mode) will push toward 1400+ lines. Requires extraction to custom hooks or state module.
